propositions: A plan edited mid-review continues through all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material mismatch, wasting all post-edit billing and checkpoint work.
The cancel probe must scope to own material only (excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision) to avoid reintroducing bug d70a false cancels on unrelated ticket writes.

The cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked before recovery paths in produce_plan_review_verdict, because step-like exceptions are caught and recovered into findings verdicts that flow to signing and sidecar emit.

own_material_changed probes via attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context to avoid sync-lock acquisition and store-wide reads, checked at exactly two seams: plan_review_verify_inputs and plan_review_coach_inputs.

Cancelled reviews return an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding before sign_plan_review and sidecar.emit are reachable, ensuring no attestation is minted and exit code is 2.
The _chunk funnel checks review_cancelled() and returns empty results without runner calls or checkpoint I/O, defensively catching in-flight cancelled events set by the probe.
